integrity_notes: The continuous-domain proof is exact algebra and convexity; independently computed numerical quadrature and symbolic identities are corroboration. Novelty comparison was limited to inspected full texts and indexed searches; publication priority is not independently certified.
limitations: Sharp only for a fixed Laguerre scale, the first two orthonormal modes, equal in-phase damped tones, global half-line L2 data, and omega>=2a. No conclusion on discrete measurements, independently tuned carriers, or arbitrary unequal spectra.
title: Sharp carrier switching in two-mode Laguerre approximation of damped beats
